abstract: Cell fate determination is a fundamental problem in development, and oocyte specification in Drosophila melanogaster remains unclear. In their study, Wen Lu, Vladimir Gelfand and colleagues find that the microtubule polymerase Mini spindles is not only necessary but also sufficient to promote initial oocyte specification in the Drosophila melanogaster ovary. To learn more about this work, we spoke to first and corresponding author Wen Lu, and to the last author Vladimir Gelfand, a Leslie B. Arey Professor of Cell, Molecular and Anatomical Sciences at the Feinberg School of Medicine, Northwestern University, USA.
